name: raag-vscode
description: Inline coupling and instability metrics from RAAG, computed by the real analysis engine, not reimplemented in the editor.

raag.cliPath.description: Path to the raag executable. Defaults to whatever 'raag' resolves to on PATH — set this explicitly if RAAG lives in a virtual environment not activated in your shell.

raag.instabilityWarnThreshold.description: Instability value at which a file is decorated yellow.

raag.instabilityErrorThreshold.description: Instability value at which a file is decorated red.

raag.minAfferentForWarning.description: Afferent coupling floor below which instability is not decorated at all. An unstable leaf nothing depends on is not a finding — this mirrors the same gate the CLI's own violation checks use.
